encoder-checks.json.coverage: Both load bases; Send/encoder and async writes; sizes 0..2048; C0/DB escaping; fragmented mbufs; multiple queued packets; flow wakeup; byte-for-byte receive loopback; split ESC; exact full receive buffers; read rearming; simultaneous receive with pending writes; idle and ownership checks; stack restoration
encoder-checks.json.limits: Native descriptor, mbuf, queue, protocol callbacks and serial APIs modeled from SDK contracts. Logger is bypassed here and executed separately in test_ram_diagnostics.py. Does not emulate full Psion kernel, real serial hardware/driver or TCP/IP implementation.

repair-checks.json.verified: CleanupStack-protected initialization; original constructor called with factory; MComm read/write priorities; return value and saved factory frame; cleanup of full/partial initialization; destructor flags and LR; DSR/DCD mask preserves all other low handshake bits
repair-checks.json.limits: Native constructor, CleanupStack and MComm allocation/deletion APIs mocked. No hardware test or full Symbian Leave unwinding emulation.

no-diagnostic-checks.json.limits: Actual ARM driver, wrappers and no-op entries; native APIs/protocol callbacks modeled. A device comparison remains necessary.

tcpip-flow-checks.json.limits: Real ARM NIF and selected device TCPIP code paths; manager lookup, address query and higher-level notification modeled. Does not reproduce complete TCP handshake, physical UART timing or prove browser recovery.
